duration.description: Duration of the test, including SI time unit (wrk -d)

timeout.description: Socket/request timeout, including SI time unit (wrk --timeout)

lua_script.description: Path to a LuaJIT script for custom behavior (wrk -s)

headers.description: List of HTTP headers to add to requests (wrk -H). Each item is a string like 'User-Agent: wrk'. Use items field for structure if needed, but here simple list of strings is used as per wrk -H behavior.
